title: Per-Dimension Finding
description: A single finding from any dimension-bearing pipeline stage (3-8). Reused via $ref in stage output schemas.

artifact.description: Which input artifact contains the evidence (e.g., runbook, rollback_plan, itsm_record)

location.description: Specific location within the artifact (e.g., step number, field name, line)

service_ref.description: Service ID referenced in the finding, if applicable

cmdb_status.description: CMDB status of the referenced service, if applicable

remediation.description: Suggested action to resolve the finding

finding_origin.description: For cross-stage traceability — which stage produced this finding
